_readme: 30 skits for 19 Nov to 18 Dec 2026, one per day at 10:00 Asia/Dubai. Formats borrowed from medical-student outliers found on 17 Nov (vidIQ): split-screen contrast, expectation vs reality, 'Nobody: / X:', POV, transformation. Content is ours. 'fact' items carry ONE exam claim that MUST be re-verified against a guideline-grade source in the run before posting (see SKITS.md). beats/fx times are starting points: retime them to the actual clip after looking at frames.
style: Stylized 3D clay animation, Pixar-like lighting, vertical 9:16, bouncy cartoon physics, exaggerated comedic timing. Characters: NPC = a grey blocky cube-headed clay character with blank dot eyes, a tiny flat mouth and a floating white exclamation mark above his head; SIGMA = a calm, confident clay character in a navy hoodie (hood up) and black sunglasses. Match the reference images exactly. No on-screen text, no words, no logos, no music.

skits.title: 5am alarm
skits.prompt: Split screen, left and right halves, two bedrooms at 5am. Left: NPC slaps the alarm clock, it flies across the room, he rolls over and falls off the bed, landing face down in a pile of unopened textbooks. Right: SIGMA's alarm rings once, he sits up instantly, puts on sunglasses, opens a tablet showing a timed quiz and nods.
skits.caption:
Your alarm doesn't fail. You do.

Which one were you this morning? Be honest.

#EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #studymotivation #medstudentlife

skits.title: Anaphylaxis first move
skits.prompt: Split screen in a cartoon hospital ward. A clay patient with a puffy swollen face and red rash wheezes. Left: NPC panics, runs in circles, then hands the patient a single tiny antihistamine tablet on a giant silver tray. Right: SIGMA calmly takes an auto-injector and presses it into the patient's outer thigh; the patient's face deflates back to normal like a balloon and gives a thumbs up.
skits.caption:
Anaphylaxis in an adult: IM adrenaline 0.5 mg (0.5 mL of 1 mg/mL) into the anterolateral thigh. Antihistamines are not the first move.

Save this for your EMREE week.

#EMREE #anaphylaxis #emergencymedicine #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors

fact.claim: Adult anaphylaxis first-line: IM adrenaline 0.5 mg (1 mg/mL), anterolateral thigh; antihistamines are not first-line
fact.check: Resuscitation Council UK anaphylaxis guideline 2021 (or newer)

skits.title: Batch group chat
skits.prompt: Single scene, cartoon bedroom at night. NPC sits on his bed staring at a phone that explodes with hundreds of notification bubbles flying out like popcorn, burying him up to his neck. He keeps scrolling with one finger. In the background, SIGMA's phone sits face down on his desk while he studies calmly.
beats: Batch group chat, 2 weeks before EMREE.
skits.caption:
The group chat will still be there after the exam.

Send this to the friend who's typing right now.

#EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #studytips #medstudentlife

skits.title: What parents think vs reality
skits.prompt: Two-part comedy. First half: a glowing heroic version of NPC in a white coat poses dramatically on a hospital rooftop at sunset like a movie poster, wind blowing his coat. Second half: hard cut to the real NPC asleep sitting up in a hospital corridor chair at 3am, clutching a cold coffee, drooling, as a pager on his chest beeps and he jolts awake.
beats: What my parents think intern year is:
skits.caption:
My mum still thinks I'm on the cover of a medical drama.

Tag your batchmate who's living part 2.

#internlife #EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #doctorlife

skits.title: K+ 6.9 with ECG changes
skits.prompt: Split screen in a cartoon resus bay with a heart monitor showing tall spiky waves. Left: NPC grabs a giant banana and starts peeling it nervously while the monitor spikes wildly and sparks fly. Right: SIGMA calmly pushes a syringe into an IV line, the monitor waves smooth out into calm gentle waves, and he lowers his sunglasses.
beats: NPC: panics. Waits for the repeat.
SIGMA: IV calcium first. Protect the heart.
skits.caption:
Hyperkalaemia with ECG changes: IV calcium first to stabilise the myocardium. It doesn't lower K+. Insulin-glucose does that next.

Save this.

#EMREE #hyperkalemia #emergencymedicine #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors

fact.claim: Hyperkalaemia with ECG changes: give IV calcium first to stabilise the myocardium; it does not lower K+; then insulin-glucose
fact.check: UK Kidney Association hyperkalaemia guideline 2023 or Resuscitation Council UK

skits.title: One more episode
skits.prompt: Single scene, a cozy cartoon bedroom. NPC lies under a blanket watching a glowing laptop, the window behind him changes rapidly from night to sunrise to full daylight in a time-lapse while his eyes get wider and redder, a mountain of snack wrappers grows around him. At the end a rooster bursts through the window.
skits.caption:
The series will still be there in December. Your exam date won't move.

What show is stealing your study hours? Comment it.

#EMREE #medicalinterns #procrastination #UAEdoctors #studytok

skits.title: Nobody: / The EMREE:
skits.prompt: Single scene, a dramatic cartoon exam hall. A giant floating clay exam paper character with angry eyebrows towers over a tiny NPC at his desk. The exam paper grows taller and taller, casting a huge shadow, and slowly slides five identical-looking answer cards toward NPC, who sweats buckets until a small puddle forms under his chair.
skits.caption:
Every option is correct. Only one is correct FIRST.

That's the whole EMREE in one sentence. Agree?

#EMREE #EMREEprep #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #DHA

skits.title: DKA with K+ 3.1
skits.prompt: Split screen, cartoon ICU. A sweaty clay patient breathes fast and deep. Left: NPC proudly hangs an insulin drip labelled with a cartoon syringe icon, then a tiny heart character on the monitor starts dancing chaotically and falls over. Right: SIGMA hangs a fluid bag and a small potassium bag first, checks a lab tablet, waits, then nods.
beats: SIGMA: fluids + K+ first. Insulin when K+ is 3.5+.
skits.caption:
DKA with K+ below 3.5: start fluids, replace potassium, and hold insulin until K+ is at least 3.5. Insulin pushes K+ into cells.

Save it for nights.

#EMREE #DKA #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #internlife

fact.claim: DKA: if K+ < 3.5 mmol/L, give fluids and potassium and delay insulin until K+ >= 3.5
fact.check: ADA/EASD/JBDS hyperglycemic crises consensus report, Diabetes Care 2024

skits.title: 47 free PDFs

NPC sits at a desk as a laptop shoots out stacks of paper like a printer gone crazy, the paper tower grows to the ceiling and then collapses on him in an avalanche until only his floating exclamation mark pokes out. SIGMA walks past in the background holding one slim tablet and shakes his head.
skits.caption:
The hard drive is ready for the EMREE. Are you?

#EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #studytips #medstudentlife

That green screen feeling is earned weeks before the email.

#EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #exammotivation #doctorlife

skits.title: Tension pneumothorax
skits.prompt: Split screen, cartoon trauma bay. A clay patient with one side of the chest puffed up like a balloon gasps for air. Left: NPC pushes the patient on a trolley toward a big X-ray machine that slowly beeps 'loading', the patient's chest balloon keeps growing. Right: SIGMA quickly decompresses the chest with a needle at the side of the chest, a comic hiss of air escapes and the patient sighs in relief.
beats: NPC: sends for a chest X-ray.
skits.caption:
Tension pneumothorax is a clinical diagnosis. Decompress first, imaging later.

Where do you put the needle in an adult? Comment it.

#EMREE #ATLS #trauma #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors

fact.claim: Tension pneumothorax is a clinical diagnosis; immediate decompression without waiting for chest X-ray

skits.title: The study plan
skits.prompt: Single scene. NPC proudly unrolls a colour-coded study timetable that is so long it rolls out the door, down the stairs and into the street. He then sits down, puts the timetable on the wall, and immediately falls asleep on the desk. SIGMA in the background is already halfway through a small simple checklist.
beats: NPC spent 6 hours making a study plan.
SIGMA: 40 questions a day. That's it.
skits.caption:
Pretty timetables don't sit the exam.

What's your daily question target? Comment the number.

#EMREE #studyplan #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #studytips

skits.title: Drug of choice reflex
skits.prompt: Quiz-show scene: a cartoon game show stage with bright lights and two buzzers. NPC and SIGMA stand at podiums. A giant question card flips. NPC slams his buzzer so hard it breaks and he shouts confidently with a speech bubble full of question marks. SIGMA presses calmly once, confetti falls only on his side, a trophy drops into his hands.
skits.caption:
Convulsive status epilepticus: benzodiazepine first line (e.g. IV lorazepam, or buccal midazolam if no IV). Second-line drugs come after.

Save this.

#EMREE #statusepilepticus #emergencymedicine #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors

fact.claim: Convulsive status epilepticus: benzodiazepine is first-line; antiseizure second-line (levetiracetam/phenytoin/valproate) after
fact.check: NICE NG217 epilepsies (2022) or ESETT-based AES guideline

skits.title: Long weekend
skits.prompt: Split screen, sunny cartoon beach on the left and a cozy desk on the right, festive lights and small green, white, red and black bunting decorations in both halves. Left: NPC lies on a beach chair under a giant umbrella with a pile of textbooks used as a pillow, sunburnt bright red. Right: SIGMA enjoys a short coffee break on a balcony with the festive lights, then sits back down to a tablet with a smile.
skits.caption:
Happy Eid Al Etihad. Enjoy it, then sit one timed mock. Both can be true.

Who's studying this weekend? Raise your hand in the comments.

#EidAlEtihad #EMREE #UAEdoctors #medicalinterns #UAE

skits.title: Suspected meningitis
skits.prompt: Split screen, cartoon emergency room. A clay patient lies under a blanket with a thermometer glowing red, shielding eyes from the light. Left: NPC fills out an enormous stack of CT request forms, the stack grows over his head while a clock behind him spins rapidly. Right: SIGMA draws blood cultures quickly and then connects an IV antibiotic bag, the patient's thermometer cools to blue.
beats: NPC: waits for CT + LP first.
SIGMA: cultures, then IV antibiotics now.
skits.caption:
Suspected bacterial meningitis and the LP will be delayed: take blood cultures and give IV antibiotics now. Don't wait.

Save this for the exam.

#EMREE #meningitis #emergencymedicine #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors

fact.claim: Suspected bacterial meningitis: if LP cannot be done promptly, take blood cultures and start IV antibiotics without waiting for LP/CT
fact.check: NICE NG240 Meningitis (bacterial) and meningococcal disease (2024)

skits.title: Flashcard deck
skits.prompt: Single scene. NPC opens a flashcard app on a phone and a giant counter above his head shows a huge red number that keeps rising, the number grows so heavy it crushes him into the floor like a pancake. SIGMA walks by with a small steady green number above his head, steps over him politely.
beats: NPC: skips flashcard reviews for 9 days.
skits.caption:
Spaced repetition only works if you show up.

How many cards are due for you right now? Be brave.

#EMREE #anki #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #studytips

skits.title: Picks option A every time
skits.prompt: Single scene, cartoon exam hall. NPC sits at an exam desk, reads exactly one word of each question, then smashes the first answer bubble with a giant hammer, sending sparks flying, and moves to the next question at turbo speed. He finishes in seconds, leans back with crossed arms and a smug face, while everyone else is still working. A grey rain cloud slowly forms over his head.
skits.caption:
The question is in the last line. The clues are in the first.

Tag the friend who finishes exams in half the time.

#EMREE #examtips #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #medstudentlife

skits.title: Unconscious hypo, no IV
skits.prompt: Split screen, a cartoon home living room. A clay patient lies unconscious on the sofa, a glucometer shows a tiny number. Left: NPC tries to pour a glass of orange juice into the unconscious patient's mouth, juice spills everywhere and NPC slips on it. Right: SIGMA gives a quick injection into the patient's thigh, the patient opens his eyes, sits up and blinks.
beats: NPC: pours juice into his mouth.
skits.caption:
Unconscious hypoglycaemia with no IV access: IM glucagon 1 mg. Never oral glucose to someone who can't protect their airway.

Save it.

#EMREE #hypoglycemia #emergencymedicine #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors

fact.claim: Adult hypoglycaemia, unconscious, no IV access: glucagon 1 mg IM; no oral glucose if unable to swallow safely
fact.check: JBDS-IP hypoglycaemia guideline (latest) or ADA Standards of Care 2026

skits.title: Consultant asks one question

skits.title: Haematemesis, BP 85/50
skits.prompt: Split screen, cartoon emergency bay. A pale clay patient holds a bowl, looking very weak, the BP monitor flashes low. Left: NPC immediately pushes the trolley at top speed toward a door labelled with a cartoon camera icon, the patient bouncing on the trolley and turning greener. Right: SIGMA places two large IV lines, hangs fluids and a blood bag, the monitor numbers rise, then calmly wheels the patient to the camera room.
skits.caption:
Upper GI bleed with shock: resuscitate first (large-bore access, fluids, blood), then endoscopy immediately after resuscitation.

Save this.

#EMREE #GIbleed #emergencymedicine #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors

fact.claim: Severe acute upper GI bleed with shock: resuscitate first, endoscopy immediately after resuscitation
fact.check: NICE CG141 acute upper GI bleeding (latest update)

skits.title: Skips Public Health

The grey door slowly opens behind him and a giant cartoon hand reaches out and drags him back inside by the ankle.

The specialty you skip is the one that shows up 10 times.

Which one are you avoiding? Be honest.

skits.title: Coffee count

NPC drinks cup after cup of coffee, each cup appears faster, his body starts vibrating at higher and higher frequency until he becomes a blur, his exclamation mark spins like a propeller and he lifts off the chair and hovers. 4 weeks becomes 1 week faster than you think.

skits.title: Reads the explanations

Right: SIGMA gets a red X, calmly scrolls down and reads the explanation, a little lightbulb pops above his head, next question shows a green check.
beats: SIGMA: reads why every option is wrong.
skits.caption:
A wrong answer you understand beats a right answer you guessed.

Do you read the explanations? Yes or no in the comments.

#EMREE #EMREEprep #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #studytips

skits.title: Testicular torsion
skits.prompt: Split screen, cartoon emergency department. A teenage clay patient clutches his stomach in pain on a trolley, wincing. Left: NPC books an ultrasound appointment on a giant calendar and points to a date far in the future, a clock spins. Right: SIGMA calls the surgeon on a phone and pushes the trolley straight through swinging doors marked with a scalpel icon.
skits.caption:
Suspected testicular torsion: urgent surgical exploration. Don't let imaging delay theatre.

Save this.

#EMREE #urology #emergencymedicine #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors

fact.claim: Suspected testicular torsion: urgent surgical exploration; imaging should not delay surgery
fact.check: EAU Paediatric Urology guideline (latest) or NICE CKS scrotal pain

skits.title: 5 minute break
skits.prompt: Single scene. NPC sets a kitchen timer for a short break and lies on the sofa with a phone. The room around him changes: plants grow tall, dust builds up, cobwebs form, the timer gathers dust, his beard grows long, while he keeps scrolling. Finally the timer rings weakly.
skits.caption:
Short breaks work. Short breaks with a phone don't.

Tag the friend whose breaks have breaks.

#EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #pomodoro #studytips

skits.title: First mock score

Right: SIGMA sees the same low score, nods, pins it on the wall, then the scene time-lapses as the scores pinned on the wall climb higher and higher, ending in a glowing green score.
beats: SIGMA: uses it as the map.
skits.caption:
Your first mock tells you where to look, not who you are.

What was your first mock score? No judgment here.

#EMREE #mockexam #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #studymotivation

skits.title: Walking into the exam
skits.prompt: Split screen, an exam centre entrance. Left: NPC walks toward the door shaking like jelly, sweating, clutching ten books, tripping over his own feet. Right: SIGMA walks in slow motion like a movie hero, hood up, sunglasses on, wind blowing, calmly holding only an ID card, sparks of light behind him.
beats: SIGMA: did the work weeks ago.
skits.caption:
Confidence on exam day is just preparation you did earlier.

Comment SIGMA if that's going to be you.
